sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2024
sources.text: While underway, five perpetrators armed with knives and guns were sighted in the engine room. The ship general alarm was raised and crew mustered. A search was conducted. All crew members were accounted for, no injury to crew and no assistance required. The master reported the incident to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information Service (VTIS).
